name: adjust_volume
description: Adjusts the volume by a certain percentage. If a specific setting is requested but does not exist in the database, a DeviceNotFoundError is raised. When adjusting ALARM, CALL, MEDIA, NOTIFICATION, and RING together (None or UNSPECIFIED), non-existent ones are skipped.

by.description:
The amount to adjust the volume by, in percentage points. Can be positive or negative.
Values are clamped between 0 and 100 after adjustment.
Note: Boolean values are accepted and coerced to integers (False→0, True→1).

setting.description:
The specific stream volume to adjust. If None or "UNSPECIFIED", adjusts ALARM, CALL, MEDIA, NOTIFICATION, and RING by the same delta (STREAM_VOLUME_SETTING_TYPES).
Valid options: "ALARM", "CALL", "MEDIA", "NOTIFICATION", "RING", "VOLUME", "UNSPECIFIED".

name: connect_wifi
description:
Connects to a specific WiFi network.

This function automatically turns on WiFi if it is currently off. If the WiFi settings do not exist, they will be initialized with default values. The function performs a network scan to discover available networks only if the specified network is not already in the available_networks list. It then attempts to connect to the specified network. The function can connect to networks that are either currently available (in the available_networks list) or previously saved (in the saved_networks list). If the network is successfully connected, it will be added to the saved_networks list if not already present. The function also persists the current available_networks list back to settings.

Note: The network_name parameter will have leading and trailing whitespace automatically stripped before processing.

network_name.description: Name of the WiFi network to connect to. Must be a non-empty string (whitespace-only strings are not allowed). Leading and trailing whitespace will be automatically stripped. The network must be either currently available in the available_networks list (discovered via scan) or previously saved in the saved_networks list. Note: The existence check is performed as business logic - if the network is not found, a normal failure response is returned (not a ValidationError).

name: get
description: Gets the current value of a device setting. If the setting does not exist in the database, returns realistic default values (toggleable settings: "off", percentage-based settings: vary by type).

setting_type.description:
Setting to get the value of. Must be one of the getable device settings.
Case insensitive - accepts both uppercase and lowercase.
Valid values include: "AIRPLANE_MODE", "ALARM_VOLUME", "AUTO_ROTATE", "BATTERY",
"BATTERY_SAVER", "BLUETOOTH", "BRIGHTNESS", "CALL_VOLUME", "DO_NOT_DISTURB", "FLASHLIGHT",
"HOT_SPOT", "MEDIA_VOLUME", "NETWORK", "NFC", "NIGHT_MODE", "NOTIFICATION_VOLUME",
"RING_VOLUME", "TALK_BACK", "VOLUME", "VIBRATION", "WIFI"

name: get_app_notification_status
description: Gets the current notification setting for a specific app.

app_name.description: Name of the app to get notification settings for. Must be a non-empty string (after trimming whitespace). Leading and trailing whitespace will be automatically trimmed. The app must be installed on the device. Case-insensitive and whitespace-insensitive matching is used (e.g., "Messages" == "messages" == "appstore" for "App Store"). Raises ValidationError if app_name is empty/whitespace-only or AppNotInstalledError if the app is not installed.

name: get_device_insights
description: Generates device insights based on user's current device state.

device_state_type.description:
The type of device state to get insights for. If None or "UNCATEGORIZED",
returns general device insights. Valid options: "UNCATEGORIZED", "BATTERY", "STORAGE"

name: get_installed_apps
description: Retrieves a list of all applications installed on the device, excluding their notification settings.

name: mute
description: Mutes one or all stream volumes (ALARM, CALL, MEDIA, NOTIFICATION, RING).

setting.description:
The specific stream volume to mute. If None or "UNSPECIFIED", mutes ALARM, CALL, MEDIA, NOTIFICATION, and RING (STREAM_VOLUME_SETTING_TYPES).
Valid options: "ALARM", "CALL", "MEDIA", "NOTIFICATION", "RING", "VOLUME", "UNSPECIFIED".
Default: None (mutes those stream volumes when omitted).

Setting to turn off. Must be one of the toggleable device settings.
Case insensitive - accepts both uppercase and lowercase.
Valid values include: "AIRPLANE_MODE", "AUTO_ROTATE", "BATTERY_SAVER",
"BLUETOOTH", "DO_NOT_DISTURB", "FLASHLIGHT", "HOT_SPOT", "NETWORK",
"NFC", "NIGHT_MODE", "TALK_BACK", "VIBRATION", "WIFI"

name: on
description: Turns on a device setting. When AIRPLANE_MODE is turned on, all wireless radios (WIFI, BLUETOOTH, NFC, HOT_SPOT, NETWORK) that are currently on are automatically turned off to match real-device behavior. The names of the radios that were transitioned to off are reported in the result message.

setting.description:
Setting to turn on. Must be one of the toggleable device settings.
Case insensitive - accepts both uppercase and lowercase.
Valid values include: "AIRPLANE_MODE", "AUTO_ROTATE", "BATTERY_SAVER",
"BLUETOOTH", "DO_NOT_DISTURB", "FLASHLIGHT", "HOT_SPOT", "NETWORK",
"NFC", "NIGHT_MODE", "TALK_BACK", "VIBRATION", "WIFI"

name: open
description: Returns an action summary describing the settings page to open for a given setting type. The client uses this to perform the actual navigation.

setting_type.description:
Setting to open. Can be a DeviceSettingType enum value as string.
Case insensitive - accepts both uppercase and lowercase (e.g. "BLUETOOTH", "bluetooth", and "bLuEtOoTh" are all accepted and normalized to "BLUETOOTH" by the backend).
Use "UNSPECIFIED" if the user only mentions "settings."
If None or UNSPECIFIED, open general device settings page.
Valid values (case insensitive): "UNSPECIFIED", "ACCESSIBILITY", "ACCOUNT", "AIRPLANE_MODE", "ALARM_VOLUME", "APPLICATION", "APP_DATA_USAGE", "AUTO_ROTATE", "BATTERY", "BATTERY_SAVER", "BIOMETRIC", "BLUETOOTH", "BLUETOOTH_PAIRING", "BRIGHTNESS", "CALL_VOLUME", "CAST", "DARK_THEME", "DATA_SAVER", "DATE_TIME", "DEVELOPER_OPTION", "DEVICE_INFO", "DISPLAY", "DO_NOT_DISTURB", "FLASHLIGHT", "GEMINI", "GRIDWELL_ASSISTANT", "HOT_SPOT", "INTERNAL_STORAGE", "LANGUAGE", "LOCATION", "LOCK_SCREEN", "MEDIA_VOLUME", "NETWORK", "NFC", "NIGHT_MODE", "NOTIFICATION", "NOTIFICATION_VOLUME", "PASSWORD", "PHONE_NUMBER", "PRIVACY", "RINGTONE", "RING_VOLUME", "SECURITY", "SYSTEM_UPDATE", "TALK_BACK", "TEXT_TO_SPEECH", "VIBRATION", "VOLUME", "VPN", "WIFI"

name: set_app_notification_status
description: Sets the current notification setting for a specific app.

app_name.description: Name of the app to modify. Must be a non-empty string. Case-insensitive matching is performed against installed apps. The app must be installed on the device.

notifications.description: The notification state to set. Must be either "on" or "off" (case-insensitive). Whitespace is automatically trimmed and the value is normalized to lowercase before validation.

name: set_volume
description: Sets stream volume(s) to a specific percentage.

to.description: The volume level to set to, in percentage points. Must be between 0 and 100.

setting.description: Audio stream volume to set. Omit or pass UNSPECIFIED to set every stream (ALARM, CALL, MEDIA, NOTIFICATION, RING) to the same level. When provided, the value must be one of these exact uppercase strings: "ALARM", "CALL", "MEDIA", "NOTIFICATION", "RING", "VOLUME", "UNSPECIFIED". "UNSPECIFIED" matches the same behavior as null (all listed streams share the same level). Any other string is invalid.

name: unmute
description: Unmutes stream volume(s) by restoring to default levels only if the current level is 0 (muted). Levels already above 0 are left unchanged.

setting.description:
The specific stream volume to unmute. If None or "UNSPECIFIED", unmutes ALARM, CALL, MEDIA, NOTIFICATION, and RING where level is 0 (STREAM_VOLUME_SETTING_TYPES).
Valid options: "ALARM", "CALL", "MEDIA", "NOTIFICATION", "RING", "VOLUME", "UNSPECIFIED"
Default levels: ALARM_VOLUME=50, CALL_VOLUME=70, MEDIA_VOLUME=60,
               NOTIFICATION_VOLUME=40, RING_VOLUME=80
Note: Unmute only acts when the volume is currently muted (at 0). If the volume is already non-zero, it will remain unchanged.
